issues.description: Eleven zodiac signs are duplicated in the grid: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces. The first set (positions 1-12 in the grid) uses base Unicode codepoints (e.g. ♈ U+2648), and the second set re-emits the same signs with a Variation Selector-16 appended (e.g. ♈️ U+2648 U+FE0F). They render identically with the same human title, so the user sees two visually identical 'Aries', 'Cancer', 'Libra', etc. cards.
issues.evidence: DOM lines 28-103 contain Aries..Pisces; lines 76-103 then duplicate Capricorn/Aquarius/Pisces/Aries/Cancer/Libra/Scorpio/Gemini/Virgo with the variation selector form. Visually confirmed in symbols-zodiac.png — row 1 has Aries, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces; row 2 repeats Pisces, Aries, Cancer, Libra; row 3 repeats Scorpio, Gemini, Virgo.

issues.description: Zodiac planet symbols are systematically mislabeled — every label is shifted/wrong. Card titled 'Uranus' shows ♄ which is the Saturn symbol. 'Uranus Symbol' shows ♀ which is the Venus symbol. 'Mars Symbol' shows ♃ which is Jupiter. 'Mercury Symbol' shows ♄ which is Saturn (and is also a duplicate glyph of the Uranus card). 'Jupiter Symbol' shows ♁ which is the Earth symbol. 'Saturn Symbol' shows ♆ which is Neptune. 'Venus Symbol' shows ♇ which is Pluto. 'Male Sign' shows ♂ (correct) but 'Men's Sign' / 'Women's Sign' earlier already covers the same.
issues.evidence: DOM lines 121-145: '♄️ Uranus', '♀ Uranus Symbol', '♃ Mars Symbol', '♄ Mercury Symbol', '♁ Jupiter Symbol', '♆ Saturn Symbol', '♇ Venus Symbol'. These are not just visually wrong — every glyph→name mapping is off.

issues.description: 'Waning Gibbous Moon' appears twice — once with glyph 🌜 (which is actually Last Quarter Moon U+1F31C) titled 'Waning Gibbous Moon' (Night Sky line above it also uses 🌙) and once correctly with 🌘 (U+1F316). Mercury also appears twice (☿ and ☿️) with names 'Mercury' and 'Mercury (Emoji)'.
issues.evidence: generated-symbols.ts line 13 maps 🌜 to 'Waning Gibbous Moon'; line 197 maps 🌘 to 'Waning Gibbous Moon'. Two cards in DOM (lines 65, 119).

issues.description: 'Sun Sign' card shows the glyph '♀♂' (Venus + Mars combined) which is not a Sun symbol — sun in astrology is ☉.
issues.evidence: generated-symbols.ts line 193: symbol '♀♂' name 'Sun Sign'. Visible in screenshot row 3.

issues.description: Same data-bug as desktop — duplicate Aries/Taurus/Gemini/Cancer/Leo/Virgo/Libra/Scorpio/Capricorn/Aquarius/Pisces cards visible in the 4-column mobile grid. Row 4 (Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Aries) and Row 5 (Cancer, Libra, Scorpio, Gemini) are visibly the second copy.
issues.evidence: symbols-zodiac mobile screenshot, rows 4-6 repeat zodiac signs already shown in rows 1-3.

issues.evidence: Mobile rows 7-8 of zodiac grid show ♄ ♀ ♃ ♁ ♆ ♇ with wrong labels — same as desktop.

issues.description: 'Snowman' appears twice in the grid: once at position 4 (☃ U+2603) titled 'Snowman' and again at the very end (☃️ U+2603 U+FE0F) also titled 'Snowman'. Same glyph, same name, just one with a variation selector — visually indistinguishable.

Several non-weather/non-nature symbols are in the weather category and many are mislabeled. '☄ Last Quarter Moon Symbol' — ☄ is the comet symbol, not a moon phase. '☉ Gibbous Moon Symbol' — ☉ is the Sun symbol. '☈ Waxing Moon Symbol' — ☈ is the thunderstorm symbol, not a moon phase. '☑ Approved Checkmark' — a checkbox, not weather/nature.
issues.evidence: DOM lines 91-103: ☄/☉/☈/☑ with wrong labels and clearly non-weather glyphs.

issues.description: '🌃 Sunset' is mislabeled — 🌃 (U+1F303) is 'Night with Stars'. The correct sunset emoji is 🌅.
Mobile grid also shows two 'Snowman' cards (top of grid and bottom of grid).
Same mislabeled weather/moon cards (☄, ☉, ☈, ☑) visible on mobile.

Multiple media-control symbols are wildly mislabeled. '⏺️ Notes' — ⏺ (U+23FA) is the Record button, not 'Notes'. '⏹️ Note With Stem Leftward' and '⏹ Note With Stem Leftward' — ⏹ (U+23F9) is the Stop button, not a musical note. '⏯ Stop Circle (Music, Video, Etc.)' — ⏯ (U+23EF) is Play/Pause, not Stop Circle.
issues.evidence: DOM lines 92-103 show this naming mismatch. Cards visible row 3 of desktop screenshot.

issues.description: Two pairs of duplicated glyphs with copy-pasted names: '⏃ Double Exclamation Mark Object' followed by '⏃⏃ Double Exclamation Mark Object Double Exclamation Mark Object', and '⏌ Leftwards Black Long Dash Arrow' followed by '⏌⏌ Leftwards Black Long Dash Arrow Leftwards Black Long Dash Arrow'. The doubled cards look like data-generation artifacts (the glyph and the title are both literally repeated twice).

'⏃ Double Exclamation Mark Object' is wrong — ⏃ (U+23C3) is actually 'Dentistry Symbol Light Down And Horizontal With Triangle'. The double-exclamation-mark Unicode codepoint is ‼ (U+203C). '⏌' (U+23CC) is 'Dentistry Symbol Light Vertical With Wave', not a 'Black Long Dash Arrow'. '⏀' (U+23C0) is 'Dentistry Symbol Light Vertical With Triangle', not the runaway 'Leftwards Arrow to Bar Over Rightwards Arrow Over Leftwards Arrow' name shown.

'⏱ Clock, Timer, Stopwatch, etc.' (U+23F1) and '⏱️ Alarm Clock' (U+23F1 U+FE0F) are the same codepoint with VS-16 — they look identical. Also 'Alarm Clock' is the wrong name; 'Alarm Clock' is ⏰ (U+23F0). The card '⏰ Alarm Clock with No Hands' is similarly wrong — ⏰ is a normal alarm clock.
The runaway label 'Leftwards Arrow to Bar Over Rightwards Arrow Over Leftwards Arrow' visibly wraps to ~7 lines and overflows the card height, breaking the otherwise consistent grid row.
issues.evidence: Card position 30 in desktop screenshot — markedly taller than its neighbours and text spills over.

issues.description: Same runaway 'Leftwards Arrow to Bar Over Rightwards Arrow Over Leftwards Arrow' label takes up a 7-line block on mobile, distorting the row height of the 4-column grid.
issues.evidence: Visible in symbols-technical mobile screenshot, row 8.

issues.description: Same media-control mislabels (⏺/⏹/⏯ titled 'Notes' and 'Note With Stem Leftward') and dentistry-symbol mislabels visible on mobile.

USER-FLAGGED 'duplicate 2 cards' confirmed — there are two superficially identical '2'-shaped cards in the grid: position 3 'Superscript Two' (² U+00B2) and position 11 'Subscript Two' (₂ U+2082). At the rendered card size both glyphs read as a small '2' in the title area, and the page-hero glyph above the H1 is also '²' (a third visible '2'). The visual repetition is what the user noticed; the labels differ but the perception is 'three 2 cards'.
issues.evidence: DOM lines 35 (²/Superscript Two) and 59 (₂/Subscript Two). Hero glyph also '²' (line 22). Screenshot shows three near-identical '2' glyphs above/inside the grid.

issues.description: Cards 15-17 are titled 'Superscript Three, Stacked' / 'Superscript Six, Stacked' / 'Superscript Seven, Stacked' / 'Superscript Eight, Stacked' but the first one (₃, U+2083) is actually a SUBSCRIPT three, not a superscript. The 'Stacked' suffix is meaningless — these are just plain superscript (and one subscript) digits already represented elsewhere or out of order. Also '⁽' (U+207D) is titled 'Superscript Right-Parenthesis' but ⁽ is the LEFT parenthesis (right-paren is ⁾).
issues.evidence: DOM lines 71-84. Card '₃ Superscript Three, Stacked' visibly differs in baseline from the '³ Superscript Three' card earlier.

issues.description: Subscript N (ₙ) and Superscript N (ⁿ) appear; in addition Superscript Three '³' (position 4) and 'Superscript Three, Stacked' '₃' (position 15, actually a subscript) repeat the digit 3 which is confusing.
Same user-flagged duplicate '2' visual appears on mobile in a 4-col grid; ² (Superscript Two) and ₂ (Subscript Two) both read as a small '2' in the card. The hero glyph at the top is also '²'.
issues.evidence: Mobile screenshot row 1 col 3 ('Superscript Two') and row 3 col 3 ('Subscript Two').

Card title '🔡 Input Symbol forSymbols' is missing a space between 'for' and 'Symbols' — looks like a string-concatenation bug.
issues.evidence: DOM line 75. Visible in desktop screenshot row 2 col 5.

Multiple non-UI symbols dumped into UI category, plus several wrong labels. '☗ Chess Pawn' / '☖ Chess Rook' belong in chess. '⚑ Crown' is wrong — ⚑ (U+2691) is 'Black Flag', not crown. '⚔ Diamond Suit' is wrong — ⚔ (U+2694) is 'Crossed Swords', not the diamond suit (♦). '🔑 Closed lock, used for certification as legal symbol' — 🔑 is a key emoji, the title is a copy of the legal-padlock description. '🔢 Input Symbol for Numbers 2' duplicates '🔠 Input Symbol for Numbers' (the '2' suffix suggests a deduping fallback).
issues.evidence: DOM lines 71-129. Grid visibly contains chess pieces and the 'Crown' card has a flag glyph.

issues.description: '⚠️ High Temperature Warning' is mislabeled — ⚠ (U+26A0) is the generic warning sign; 'High Temperature Warning' is a different concept. '🔄 Counterclockwise Arrows Button' renders correctly but the codepoint is in fact the 🔃 'Clockwise Vertical Arrows' family — verify.
Same 'Input Symbol forSymbols' missing-space bug visible on mobile.

issues.evidence: DOM lines 816-844 (e.g. '(╯≧◕≦╰) click to copy', '(◯ᵕ◯) click to copy', '(^ω^)`Д´) click to copy', etc. — 14 entries with no name).
